macros.name: examperiod
macros.doc: Specifies the period of the exam, s1 for January/End of Semester 1, s2 for May/End of Semester 2, or resit for Supplementary exams (Summer Resits).

macros.name: guidance
macros.doc: Sets a ’guidance’ paragraph on the cover page.

macros.name: guidancea
macros.doc: Sets a ’guidance’ paragraph at the start of section A only.

macros.name: guidanceb
macros.doc: Sets a ’guidance’ paragraph at the start of section B only.

macros.name: module
macros.doc: The code (including the 3-letter prefix) and full name of the module.

macros.name: nfrom
macros.doc: The number of compulsory questions from the selection available in the options part of the exam.

macros.name: notesallowed
macros.doc: Marks the exam as allowing notes.

macros.name: school
macros.doc: The name of the school setting this exam, provided in both English and Welsh.

macros.name: sectiona
macros.doc: Only applies when class option ab is active. Begins the compulsory Section A.

macros.name: sectionb
macros.doc: Only applies when class option ab is active. Begins the student-choice Section B.

macros.name: timeallowed
macros.doc: The amount of time allowed in hours.

envs.name: horizontalchoices
envs.doc: The choices environment presents one choice per line, whereas the horizontalchoices environment lays out choices in a single paragraph, wrapping lines wherever necessary.
